invariants.rationale: writeMetadata must be non-null because its method getWriteStatuses() is called.
result is constructed and returned, so it is never null.
getWriteStatuses() is used to build the result and is thus non-null at method exit.
result is created as a TableWriteStats, confirming its type.
Result is built by mapping each WriteStatus to a stat, so the list sizes are equal.
